text_description: Full runway look built around an oversized, thigh-length gray coat with a dense long-pile fuzzy surface, soft rounded volume through the shoulders and sleeves, and a double-breasted front marked by small dark buttons. The coat has a broad notched collar and large lapels, with the front crossing diagonally and opening slightly at the lower center to reveal a pale pink pointed shirt collar at the neckline and a taupe-beige mini underlayer beneath. The silhouette is cocoon-like and heavy on top, ending high on the thigh so one bare leg is prominently exposed while the opposite lower leg is styled with a vivid red knee-high sock or stocking. A gray ribbed knit beanie with a folded edge sits close to the head, coordinating with the coat. The model carries a pale gray-blue structured top-handle handbag with a rounded trapezoid shape and visible textured surface. Footwear appears pale gray and fuzzy, low-cut with a soft rounded toe and a small dark bow or tie detail across the vamp; thin strap-like elements are visible around the foot. The styling combines soft gray winter textures with flashes of pale pink, beige, and bright red for an offbeat, layered cold-weather mini silhouette.
key_elements: oversized gray long-pile fuzzy double-breasted coat
broad notched collar and diagonal wrapped front
pale pink pointed shirt collar visible underneath

pale gray-blue structured top-handle textured handbag

pale fuzzy shoes with dark bow/tie detail
uncertainty_notes: The taupe underlayer is only partially visible and could be a mini skirt, shorts, or another short garment.
The exact shoe construction and strap placement are partly obscured by motion and angle.
A small red detail at one sleeve/hand area may be a glove or cuff but is not fully clear.
